raiz.texto: Vireya asserts the sovereign right to harvest moisture from the airspace above its territory and will energize Phase II on the announced schedule. It offers voluntary seasonal telemetry summaries but rejects any binding capture quota, calling downwind attribution scientifically unproven. It frames the Array as the only remedy for its structural drought and the foundation of highland development, and states it will protect the project against any interference.
